title: Galician Paella Risotto
description: A twist on the classic Italian risotto, incorporating the flavors of Galician paella. This dish is a fusion of Italian and Spanish cuisine.
instructions: Heat the vegetable broth in a separate pot and keep warm.
In a large skillet, sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic until softened.
Add the smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the white wine and cook until the liquid is almost completely reduced.
Add the Arborio rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, until coated in oil and slightly toasted.
Add 1 cup of warm vegetable broth to the rice and stir until absorbed. Repeat this process, adding the broth in 1-cup increments, and waiting for it to be absorbed before adding more.
After 20-25 minutes of cooking, the rice should be tender and creamy. Stir in the crumbled blue cheese and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Season with salt and serve immediately, topped with grated Parmesan and chopped parsley if desired.
